name: Danira
summary: Danira is composed with striking balance, uniting the radiance of brass with the quiet strength of silvery grey travertine marble. The central top and legs glow in a metallic lacquer finish, while the flanking marble panels offer a soft matte surface alive with natural veining. Matte black connectors refine the composition, introducing depth and definition. The result is a piece of architectural elegance where contrast becomes harmony.
